thread:
emma_billing: Heads-up — NordTech Oy (FI) invoice #INV-2026-009 is blocked. Customer uploaded a resale certificate plus a bank confirmation letter but VIES check failing with 'country mismatch' and our billing auto-verify is rejecting. They also sent PO #PO-4332. Need manual reverse-charge application for this invoice.

olga_accounting: Can you paste the VAT ID and the exact VIES error? Also which file types were uploaded?

emma_billing: VAT: FI12345678. VIES response: 'Member State code does not match VAT number country' (code 201). Uploads were PDF (resale_cert.pdf) and bank_letter.jpg. Bank letter shows address in 'Åland Islands' — that might be the mismatch. Customer insists company HQ is in mainland Finland.

marc_support: @emma_billing — since VIES is flaky for subregions like Åland we can do a manual override. Two options: 1) accept resale cert + supporting bank letter + PO, mark invoice exempt; 2) request national tax authority certificate. Which do you prefer?

emma_billing: Customer pushed for immediate release to avoid service interruption. They provided a corporate registry extract and proof-of-payment routing showing same VAT id. Recommend manual override for this case.

olga_accounting: OK. Please attach screenshots of the registry extract + bank letter. I'll run the internal checklist: resale cert OK, PO present, bank name matches, registry extract matches VAT id. If all good I'll approve.

sophie_support: FYI if you need to do override via admin UI:
```
Admin > Billing > Invoices > INV-2026-009 > Actions > SetTaxExemption(manual)
Add note: "Approved: registry + bank letter + PO 4332"
```
This will create billing ticket BT-4521.

devbot: Ticket created: BT-4521 — manual tax override requested by olga_accounting. Assignee: olga_accounting.

liam_sales: Heads-up to account team — customer threatened to pause usage if invoice not released today. Please coordinate communication. :warning:

olga_accounting: Approved and applied manual override. Invoice released at 11:24 CET. Added evidence to ticket. Marking resolved unless QA needs follow-up.

emma_billing: Thanks team, customer confirmed payment routing resumed, services green. Closing from my side. :tada:
